head: 6b24d1656e73586262d3d2aaaa276903f0d9157f
tool_resolution: Host repo has no Playwright/Cypress/Storybook and no feature_verification.command. Adding a browser dependency here is an 'Ask first' boundary in AGENTS.md, so no dependency was added. Used the Playwright already installed in the sibling codemie-test-harness poetry venv (codemie-test-harness-zcd7CGSE-py3.13) plus its cached Chromium.
existing_coverage_reviewed: ../codemie-sdk/test-harness/codemie_test_harness/tests/ui/datasource/ has UI datasource specs, but they require the full CodeMie stack (API :8080 + IDP) which is not running and cannot be started from this repo (docker-compose.yml here serves only the UI). They also need a live Jira integration to populate this field.
app_under_test: vite dev server on :5199 serving a temporary entry that renders the real JiraCustomFieldsField inside the exact IndexTypeJira wrapper markup, against the app's real global SCSS + Tailwind cascade; GET /api/v1/index/jira/fields stubbed at the network layer

features.route: /datasources/create and /datasources/:id/edit (both render the same DataSourceForm -> IndexTypeField.Jira)
assertions: 8 selected chips wrap to multiple rows
horizontal gap between adjacent chips >= 4px (not merged)
vertical gap between chip rows >= 4px (not cramped)
no chip painted outside the control box (not clipped)
control height grows with content (max-height released)
visible vertical space between the embeddings field and the Custom fields label
identical geometry in codemieLight and codemieDark
zero console errors and zero network failures
